# Lavieri Group LLC

> Miami-based automotive and collector services, founded by Luca Lavieri.

## Services
- [Car Brokerage](https://www.lavierigroup.com/service-page/car-brokerage-services): Classic, exotic, and collector car sourcing; import-export coordination.
- [Limo Service](https://www.lavierigroup.com/service-page/limo-service): Private chauffeur arrangements in Miami and South Florida.
- [LLC Formation](https://www.lavierigroup.com/service-page/llc-formation): Automotive business formation support.
- [Memorabilia Sourcing](https://www.lavierigroup.com/service-page/memorabilia-sourcing): Automotive art and racing memorabilia sourcing.

## Company and portfolio
- [Portfolio](https://www.lavierigroup.com/portfolio): Car transactions and memorabilia examples, not a statement of current inventory.
